target: For every nonnegative initial offset c, natural finite horizon T, real increment stream b with b_t>=0 for t<T, and real function f continuous, nonincreasing and nonnegative on [0,infinity), define s_0=c and s_(t+1)=s_t+b_t. Then sum(t<T)b_t*f(s_(t+1)) is at most the integral of f from c to s_T. All zero cases are included. One reusable integral-comparison lemma is a prerequisite for the required Chapter2 adaptive-rate forward claim. Actual causal adaptive OSD, zero-gradient skipping, zero-radius/zero-energy cases, inverse-square-root energy summation, Eq.(4.4), Theorem4.14 and its displayed minimum-versus-infimum edge remain required/open. All eight Chapter2 forward containers and six future mathematical claims remain required/open. Chapter2 remains partial with null complete proof total; Chapters3-16 remain unenumerated/null. Chapter4 is not a new main task. Whole Chapters1-16 Goal ACTIVE. Stacked on OPEN draft unmerged PR215 exact 8f31042350bd8eeb1c9108257c58e2b3aafaebfb. No merge, deployment, main/live or retirement claim.
